name: Range Slider
hint: Drag either thumb, or click the track.
description: Dual-thumb range with a histogram behind the track that lights up inside the selected range, so people see how much their filter keeps. Two keyboard sliders, and hidden inputs that carry both ends in a form.
usage: Use in filter panels for numeric ranges (price, size, year). Set `min`, `max`, `step` and `label` (or `aria-label`), then `value` + `onChange` (controlled, [low, high]) or `defaultValue`. Use `onChangeEnd` to fetch results once a drag or key press is done instead of on every move. `formatValue` formats the numbers on screen and for screen readers (or use `prefix`). Pass real counts in `data` so the histogram tells the truth; with no `data` there is no histogram. Set `name` to submit both ends in a <form>.

keyboard.does: Moves to the low thumb, then to the high thumb.
Moves the focused thumb up one step.
Moves the focused thumb down one step.
Moves the focused thumb ten steps up or down.
Moves the focused thumb ten steps.
Moves the focused thumb to the lowest or highest value it may take; the thumbs stay one step apart and never cross.

screenReader: A group named by `label` (or `aria-label`) holding two sliders named by `minLabel` and `maxLabel`. Each says its value through `formatValue` (or `prefix`), with a trailing + at the top when `openEnded`, and its range stops one step short of the other thumb; the readout of both ends is a polite live region, so a drag is announced too. With `error` both thumbs are marked invalid and the message is read as their description.

dataProps.description: Controlled range [low, high]. Pass it with onChange and the thumbs show exactly this. Leave undefined to let the slider keep its own.
Starting range when uncontrolled; also what a form reset returns to. Defaults to [min, max].
Older way to seed the low end when uncontrolled; defaultValue wins.
Older way to seed the high end when uncontrolled; defaultValue wins.
([low, high]) => void, on every move (drag, click, key).
([low, high]) => void, once when a drag ends and after each key press: the committed range.
(n: number) => string, used for the readout, the drag bubble, the end labels and aria-valuetext. Overrides `prefix`.
Counts per bin for the histogram, low to high across min-max; bars are scaled to the largest count.
Accessible name of the low thumb.
Accessible name of the high thumb.
Add "+" to the max end label ("$1,000+").
Form field name. One string submits both ends under that name (read with formData.getAll); a pair names them separately.
An error you already have, shown under the slider and announced.
Goes to the low thumb (role=slider), for focus().
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.

example:
<RangeSlider
  label="Price"
  min={0}
  max={500}
  step={5}
  name={["priceMin", "priceMax"]}
  value={price}
  onChange={setPrice}
  onChangeEnd={(range) => refetch({ price: range })}
  formatValue={(n) => `$${n}`}
  data={countsPerBin}
/>
